# T028 acceptance evidence

Active November6 from clean d71d900(T042). Git is recoverable; baseline1124
historical tracked hashes recorded, state/backlog excluded. Three absent/newRTL
paths were created before inventory; no historical source overwritten. Declared
old edits limited to registries/README/same two Nov6 reports. No UART/CPU/XPR/XDC/
architecture/clock/map/reset-priority/firmware image changes. Attended unrestricted
runtime; no downloads/install/system changes/scheduling/push/physicalprogramming.

New GPIO/input_sync:16 independent raw input bits through two ASYNC_REG stages,
selected16-bit LED OUT/SET/CLEAR, IN snapshotRO, upperlanes ignore,32-bit original
address/read response, meaningful low16 write adapter from unchanged master32.
New timer:32-bit COUNT/COMPARE, CTRL enable/auto2bits, sticky match/W1C. Counts
independently of bus holds. Count write merges pre-increment bytes and suppresses
increment/match; old control/compare used otherwise; new match beats W1C. Effects
on successful response acceptance only, one outstanding/no sameedge replacement,
reset clears all/gatesbus, malformed/RO/unmapped reads/writes error. No IRQ output.
See docs/GPIO_TIMER.md for exact interfaces/map/limits.

Independent bit-set GPIO and elapsed-epoch closed-form timer oracle, native pre/
post public-output comparison, both master hold assertions, seeds1/20261106.
Five pure reference tests PASS after preserved fixture correction: mask8 requires
originaladdr+3. Five-input archive retained. Main native preparation receipt
mmio-20261106T221416774407Z FAIL at undetected timer-clear-priority mutant: both
positive seeds/input negatives and SET mutation passed, but autoreloadcompare1
masked temporary wrongclear before observation. Preserve12input ZIP/117 generated
hashes. Strengthen with immediate STATUS read and isolated singlematch W1C case;
all productionRTL unchanged. Count-suppression mutant remains required. No
negative/check/timeout waived, no taskPASS before all required gates execute.

Required python -B scripts/harness.py finish T028 --evidence evidence/daily/T028.md
attempt1/3(next). Gates lint/test-mmio/bothwhitespace. Native driver compiles,
elaborates, checks all vectors/savesWDBs and exact negative diagnostics, three
isolated RTL faults. Registry24 retains23 predecessors; no full24regression,
formal(T023 skipped/NOT RUN), completeCDC/SoC/IRQ/timing/hardware/ASIC evidence.
After pass audit exact source/receipt/vector/summary/wave hashes and old files,
snapshot pre-gate evidence, append same two reports, reviewdiff/stage/whitespace/
commit locally, thenquery actualnext(T029 expected). Recover active task if any
before next; never selfapprove/reopen/enable. Tool versions unchanged.
